ns2:section.sectionText: In order to register for this course, you will need to complete an Independent Study Form. The form can be found on our website: https://go.illinois.edu/IndependentStudy. The form must be completed before it's submitted. It must be signed by the Instructor and Department Head, and must include the Course Subject/Number, # hours, and term, along with a project description. Once the form is completed, it may be sent to media-ssc@illinois.edu for processing.
